subject: serialization format for MCMC & metadata format?

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: serialization format for MCMC & metadata format?
parts:
The discussion about PyStan about bringing together
chains runs separately brings up a good issue.

We've been talking about C++ API-level interfaces, but
not about any kind of serialization format.

The current CSV output from CmdStan is a CSV file
for parameters and draws, with a lot of added metadata
in comments, including adaptation information and settings
for how CmdStan was run.

It'd be nice to settle on something like a simple CSV
format like this for draws. It's a bit of a hack now because
array indexing is done by name-mangling in the header.

We could compress the files to save space.

But that leaves a serialization format for all the metadata.
And for adaptation.

- Bob

messages.author: f2961c15f7afbca6
messages.subject: Re: serialization format for MCMC & metadata format?
parts:
If you're willing to punt a little on this (timewise) - What about feather? That way it also provides a bridge format so the output could be pulled into R/python/julia without issue and is lightning fast.

https://github.com/wesm/feather

The reason I mention needing to (potentially) wait is feather can only handle tabular data at the moment, so there might be some hoops needed to capture all the metadata stored in columns, but on the todo list is extending the data structures supported.
